correctness.rationale: The exact four inequalities characterize every fixed configuration. With b>=a, a mixed core k<a/2 forces l=b and contradicts 2k+b<=a+1; k>a/2 forces l=0 and contradicts 2k>=a+b-1. The only mixed case is even a with k=a/2 and l central. Uniform cores give exactly two. Full bit-level simulation of 1,206,956 states and independent occupancy checks over 500 parameter pairs match the formula. Entropy follows from Stirling.
